text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, they round the fourth corner. 
Number 8, Satono Diamond, swings out 
wide!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Finally in the home stretch... You're 
doing great so far, Dia...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, all that's left is the final 
stretch...!

Yeah, all that's left is the final 
stretch...!

text_block_list.text:
May. Satono Crown and I had come to watch 
Satono Diamond run in the Japanese Derby.

Carrying immense expectations as the new 
crown jewel presented by the Satono 
family, she became the 1st favorite in the 
Satsuki Sho, but finished in a 
heartbreaking 3rd place—

Perhaps due to that, her popularity 
dropped to 2nd favorite in this Japan 
Derby, yet the condition she showed in the 
paddock was truly remarkable.

Toned and refined even more strictly than 
for the Satsuki Sho, that body radiated a 
flawless brilliance true to its name.
...Or at least, that was how it seemed.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――They hit the wire neck and neck!! 
Th-This is a terrifyingly close contest!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Nippon Derby has gone to 
a photo finish!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew—...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The official result lamp has just turned 
on!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond takes 2nd place! In 1st 
place is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Um, according to reports just coming in... 
It appears Satono Diamond threw a shoe 
during the race.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"The horseshoe on her left leg came off 
during the run... Likely due to that 
trouble, she seemed to struggle a bit with 
her footing in the middle section."

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Still, even with those factors in play, 
following the Satsuki Sho, it's ended in a 
deeply frustrating result, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... If I remember right, in the 
Satsuki Sho, someone else's drift caused 
her to lose speed too, right? Talk about 
bad luck, or whatever you wanna call it...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like she's really giving it her 
all, so it just feels kinda unrewarding, 
ya know? I hope she's not too bummed 
out..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Let's go, Trainer.

When I headed toward the underground 
tunnel, Satono Diamond happened to be 
surrounded by the press.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Second place after a photo finish... What 
a truly heartbreaking, narrow result.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Judging by everything you've shown so far, 
I believe you have pushed yourself 
immensely to prepare to become the 
champion of this Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Winning the Classic Triple Crown... 
especially victory in the Japan Derby, was 
a goal I had to achieve no matter what it 
took.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To become a renowned Umamusume and bring 
the ultimate honor to the Satono family... 
this was a necessary victory.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...With that single-minded devotion, how 
much effort you have poured in to stand 
where you are today. As the reporter in 
charge, I know it all too well."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you were robbed of victory 
twice by what can only be described as 
unfortunate accidents.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond-san. Pardon my bluntness, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could you share your candid feelings with 
us right now?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A diamond is a gemstone renowned for its 
unmatched hardness.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many hardships strike, or 
how often. Not a single shadow shall cloud 
that brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am heading out now. And I will prepare 
myself. For the final crown, the Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To hold within my grasp the greatest honor 
dedicated to our Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much for answering.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Please let me interview you again 
sometime. It will help make the article 
about your victory all the more splendid.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, want me to guess what you're 
thinking? 'Dia, what a girl...' Is that 
it?

Simultaneously. Though it was hard to call 
it empathy, and perhaps far from true 
understanding—

I, too, thought to myself, "If it's them, 
that would be the case."

Pride as a member of the Satono family. 
Running with the dignity of someone born 
to become a legendary Umamusume—if it's 
them, they surely can.
choice_data_list:
Because I've always watched just how 
strong you all are.

Because I've watched how strong you all 
are the whole time

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... That's right, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, let's just say a quick word to 
Dia and head home.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to lose to my little 
protégé. ...I need to prepare for the 
Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. I'm all fired up now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You know... It looks like I might actually 
take 1st place in the Takarazuka Kinen fan 
vote.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
An 'me' everyone can believe in. An 'me' 
who can keep her promise to Dia-chan. I 
know... I can become that now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done yet. I can push harder and 
harder. I can become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: More, more, more, even more—!

After that... I got into the Satono family 
car that came to pick us up alongside 
Satono Crown, and on the drive back to the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah--!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: !? ...I'm sorry, please stop for a second!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *pant*... Huh? Kura-chan, and Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're pretty beaten up... You don't 
look like you're just out for a casual 
run, do you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, less of a run... and more 
heading back to the training grounds. 
They're deep in the mountains, though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I just got back from watching Dia-chan's 
Derby today, and—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a second. The mountains? Didn't 
you come from the academy?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... But we can make it back before 
the sun completely sets! It's close enough 
if we just keep running.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I haven't finished... today's 
training menu yet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Kitasan—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Special training deep in the mountains... 
Just how hard... is this girl pushing 
herself...?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So that's how it is, sorry! I've 
gotta get going now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: See you later, Kura-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Did you see? The muscle tone in her... 
hindquarters.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, that wasn't all. The overall condition 
of her body... had reached an unbelievable 
realm.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
True, she's a girl who's grown a lot since 
around last autumn, but honestly—

Going this far feels a bit suspect. Seeing 
Satono Crown look at me with eyes that say 
as much, I give a nod in agreement.
choice_data_list: This growth curve makes no sense...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I expected her to grow. But this is far 
beyond expectations.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It's almost as if... she's forcibly 
speeding up her growth—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back to the car, Trainer. As 
soon as we return to the Academy, we're 
having a meeting.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And that's after making significant 
adjustments to the predictions for her 
condition heading into the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

Confronting a rival who exhibits an 
eerie—and somewhat precarious—growth, her 
intelligent eyes gleam sharply.

The days leading up to the Takarazuka 
Kinen grew progressively more intense.
